name: The Seashell Whispers Our Name
source:
Myra is a burgeoning magickal consultant with a family background in powerful magick. She receives a request from her friend and fellow magickal enthusiast, Amadeo. Amadeo has heard rumors of a mysterious, enchanted bracelet that is traced back to Myra's hometown. After years of being away, Myra returns home to help Amadeo with his search, where she is confronted by an old flame, a dead body, and an annual festival that reopens old family wounds.

[From [url=https://blqgumi.itch.io/the-seashell-whispers-our-name]itch.io[/url]]
